question: Should the agent-status dashboard widget be accepted as a sessions.list-backed builtin now, or should this issue wait for the broader per-session activity contract before being considered solved?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested widget, and the linked pull request is an implementation candidate whose source-of-truth choice for current task and progress is a product/API sequencing decision.

options.title: Review the linked widget PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate implementation and close this issue only after that pull request or a replacement lands.

options.title: Wait for activity contract
options.body: Hold this issue until the broader per-session activity API is accepted, then require the dashboard widget to consume that richer contract.

options.title: Fold into the roadmap tracker
options.body: Move remaining sequencing into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 only if this issue's unique agent-status requirements are preserved there.

recommendation.title: Review the linked widget PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate implementation and close this issue only after that pull request or a replacement lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest routing signal is recent ownership of the Control UI plugin-tab and Sessions-page surfaces that determine how this dashboard feature should land.
